conbody.p: Shift-lock system prevents shifting the gear from P (Park) into N (Neutral)/R (Reverse)/D (Drive) or N (Neutral) into R (Reverse)/D (Drive) unless the brake pedal is depressed.

li.p: ALWAYS check the surrounding areas near your vehicle for people, especially children, before shifting a vehicle into D (Drive) or R (Reverse).

Before leaving the driver’s seat, always make sure the vehicle is in the P (Park) position, then set the parking brake, and place the EV button in the OFF position. Unexpected and sudden vehicle movement can occur if these precautions are not followed.
Shifting into P (Park) while the vehicle is in motion may cause you to lose control of the vehicle.
After the vehicle has stopped, always make sure P (Park) is selected, apply the parking brake, and turn the vehicle off.
Do not use P (Park) in place of the parking brake.
When you park the vehicle, make sure the parking brake is applied even though the vehicle is in P (Park).
If equipped with Electronic Parking Brake (EPB), the parking brake is applied automatically when the gear is shifted to P (Park).

note.p: Always come to a complete stop before shifting into or out of R (Reverse); you may damage the Power Electric system if you shift into R (Reverse) while the vehicle is in motion, except on “Rocking the vehicle” (refer to Rocking the vehicle).

li.p: Always depress the brake pedal while shifting to another gear.
You cannot shift the gear while the charging cable is connected.
